note.c: <SP_f_AO_3a_-LIT>De Vos A. 2013a</SP_f_AO_3a_-LIT>: 178 notes that the <SP_f_AO_3a_Akkadian>puṣû</SP_f_AO_3a_Akkadian> on this model does not lie in the center of the <SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>KI.GUB</SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>, as it does in Bo 44, but to the right. Hence she hesitantly proposes a reading <SP_f_AO_3a_Akkadian><del_in/>i-n<del_fin/>a</SP_f_AO_3a_Akkadian><SP_f_AO_3a_--superscr>?</SP_f_AO_3a_--superscr> <SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>ŠÀ</SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM> <SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>KI.</SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM><SP_f_AO_3a_Akkadian><del_in/></SP_f_AO_3a_Akkadian><SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>GUB</SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM> <SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>ZAG</SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM><SP_f_AO_3a_--superscr>?</SP_f_AO_3a_--superscr><SP_f_AO_3a_Akkadian><del_fin/></SP_f_AO_3a_Akkadian>, but pointing out that there is barely room for <SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>ZAG</SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>, to which I agree. The reading <SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>ŠÀ</SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM> for the sign before <SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM>KI.GUB</SP_f_AO_3a_SumGRAM> still seems to fit the traces visible on the photos best, especially since the options for a sign with three consecutive verticals and traces of Winkelhaken in between are limited in this position in an omen protasis. Cf. Also Bo 44 (1234/v) a. 1 and Bo 15 (340/f) a. 1.
